invariant: Every Java consumer passes a resolved RoundCorner diameter through Fashion to the same USymbolStack. A cluster uses root.element.<diagramStyle>.group.stack; an explicit stack leaf uses root.element.<diagramStyle>.stack.title; EntityImageEmptyPackage uses root.element.<diagramStyle>.package.title. DESCRIPTION maps to componentDiagram and CLASS maps to classDiagram. USymbolStack rounds the inset URectangle by that diameter, uses radius RoundCorner/2 for each outer-path arc, and takes a distinct six-segment straight-line branch when RoundCorner is zero.
causal_divergence: Rust duplicated the stack painter across class and deployment renderers and neither consumer carried its resolved RoundCorner into that painter. Both hardcode a 2.5 base radius and always emit arcs. The brace-bearing class stack exposed configured nonzero drift; the standalone no-brace stack dispatches as DESCRIPTION and exposed the unchanged deployment copy under roundcorner zero.
planned_change: Resolve RoundCorner from each concrete consumer signature and carry the diameter into both stack painters. Class cluster records use classDiagram.group.stack; explicit class symbol leaves use classDiagram.stack.title; packageStyle-derived empty packages use classDiagram.package.title. Deployment leaves use componentDiagram.stack.title and deployment clusters use componentDiagram.group.stack. Both painters emit Java's exact straight path and omit rx/ry at zero; otherwise they use half the diameter for inset SVG radius and outer arcs. Preserve the generic document scaler as the only dpi/scale transform.
